title: loop_passes
description: Loop bookkeeping that most consumers can ignore: a summary of one UTC minute of the loop's passes (how many ended, how long they took, how many acted or threw), written once a minute while the loop runs. It shows the loop's pace and settings, never a stage or progress. Written by the loop's pass book.

from_at.description: The start of the UTC minute summed up, inclusive.

to_at.description: The end of that minute, exclusive: one minute after from_at.

passes.description: Passes that ended in the minute. 0 when none did; then every duration below is null.

acting.description: Of those passes, how many acted (did something rather than finding nothing to do).

errors.description: Of those passes, how many threw.

mean_ms.description: The mean duration of the passes, in milliseconds, rounded; null when there was none.

p50_ms.description: The median duration (nearest rank), in milliseconds; null when there was no pass.

p90_ms.description: The 90th percentile duration (nearest rank), in milliseconds; null when there was no pass.

max_ms.description: The longest duration, in milliseconds; null when there was no pass.

acting_mean_ms.description: The mean duration of the acting passes, in milliseconds, rounded; null when none acted.

idle_mean_ms.description: The mean duration of the passes that did not act, in milliseconds, rounded; null when every pass acted or there was none.

mode.description: The loop's mode: off, observe (plans, does not act) or act.

pass_every_ms.description: The loop's configured time between passes, in milliseconds.

observe_mean_ms.description: The mean wall time of the minute's passes' observe call, in milliseconds, rounded. Null means no pass in the minute had a measure; older loops leave the field out.

observe_commands_mean_ms.description: The mean time the passes' observe call had at least one read in flight, in milliseconds, rounded. Null means no pass in the minute had a measure; older loops leave the field out.

observe_in_process_mean_ms.description: The mean in-process time of the passes' observe call, in milliseconds, rounded. Null means no pass in the minute had a measure; older loops leave the field out.

observe_in_process_max_ms.description: The longest in-process time of any pass's observe call, in milliseconds. Null means no pass in the minute had a measure; older loops leave the field out.

input_tokens.description: The orchestrator (the loop's own main session) input tokens of the requests first found in its transcript since the previous minute's read, once per requestId; step agents are excluded (they are on loop_entry). The first read after a loop starts counts the requests made since the loop started (a new session: all of its requests), so the first minute is complete. Null when that first read cannot place the requests (the transcript's last 4 MiB hold only requests since the start), when the transcript could not be found or read, or when the runtime knows no config dir. Older loops leave the field out.

The first read after a loop starts counts the requests made since the loop started (a new session: all of its requests), so the first minute is complete. Null when that first read cannot place the requests (the transcript's last 4 MiB hold only requests since the start), when the transcript could not be found or read, or when the runtime knows no config dir. Older loops leave the field out.

The first read after a loop starts counts the requests made since the loop started (a new session: all of its requests), so the first minute is complete. Null when that first read cannot place the requests (the transcript's last 4 MiB hold only requests since the start), when the transcript could not be found or read, or when the runtime knows no config dir. Older loops leave the field out.

The first read after a loop starts counts the requests made since the loop started (a new session: all of its requests), so the first minute is complete. Null when that first read cannot place the requests (the transcript's last 4 MiB hold only requests since the start), when the transcript could not be found or read, or when the runtime knows no config dir. cost_usd.description: The what-if cost at Anthropic's public API prices of the same requests the token fields count, each priced at its own model, not a bill. Null when the tokens are null, when a model is unpriced, and on older loops.

usage_tier.description: The usage throttle tier the loop planned with (tierOf, v2 SPEC 13.5.2): the tier of the last pass that ended in the minute with a plan, so the state in force at the minute's end. Null when no pass in the minute reached a plan (passes 0, or only error passes). Older loops leave the field out.

usage_tier_overridden.description: Whether an owner override held the tier at normal (tierOf, v2 SPEC 13.5.2), for the same pass as usage_tier. Null when no pass in the minute reached a plan. Older loops leave the field out.
